decision.rationale: The disputed charge TXN-008146 is on card CRD-000152. It was made on 2026-08-30 and posted on 2026-08-31 for 56.69 EUR at Willowmere Athletic Club (MER-000072). The dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, which is 58 days after posting and within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's cancellation confirmation DOC-000079 says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-06. That is after the charge on 2026-08-30, so the charge covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: Willowmere Athletic Club charged you on 2026-08-30. Their own cancellation confirmation says your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-06, after that charge. The charge therefore covers a period before your cancellation took effect.
